headers.Subject: URGENT: Your account will be suspended in 24 hours

body_text:

Your Microsoft 365 account will be suspended within 24 hours due to a security violation. You must verify your credentials IMMEDIATELY to avoid losing access.

Click here to verify now: http://login-microsoftonline-secure.xyz/verify?user=employee@company.com

This is an automated message from Microsoft IT Security. Failure to act will result in permanent account suspension.

Microsoft Support Team
